models.name: AuditLog
models.description: AuditLog represents an immutable record of significant actions performed within the system for traceability, security auditing, and operational debugging. The model is designed to be generic and reusable across all domains. Each entry captures: - The actor who performed the action (user or system) - The type of actor (USER or SYSTEM) - The action that occurred - The affected resource and its identifier - Optional metadata for additional context - The time at which the action occurred Audit logs
